shortcuts.summary: Legacy top-level diagnostics dashboard shortcut; accepts the same flags as `abi tui`.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: Show top-level, command, subcommand, shortcut, JSON, or shell-completion help
commands.details: --json prints typed command/subcommand metadata plus top-level shortcut and completion-shell metadata for automation and docs tooling. --completion emits a shell completion script for bash, zsh, or fish.

commands.name: complete
commands.summary: Run completion through local ABI agent pipeline; --model selects catalog id, --live enables explicit live transport, --neural is in-process char-LM demo
commands.details: --model selects a catalog id, --live enables explicit live transport, --learn runs the SEA self-learning loop, --neural selects the in-process character-level demo LM (mutually exclusive with --model; not a production LLM), and apple-fm requires --confirm. Use `--` before a prompt that starts with `-`.

args.name: live
args.help: serve anthropic models over the live transport

args.name: soul
args.help: soul layout JSON file for neural routing

args.name: soul-alpha
args.help: blend weight for soul neural routing (0.0-1.0)

args.name: neural
args.help: in-process char-LM demo (not a production LLM); mutually exclusive with --model

args.name: model
args.help: select a catalog model id (e.g. claude-fable-5)

commands.name: train
commands.summary: Run the AI pipeline compatibility trainer

commands.name: agent
commands.summary: Agent planning, training, TUI, multi-worker orchestration, browser planning, OS-control
commands.details: Subcommands: plan, train, tui, multi, spawn (custom workers), browser (local orchestration), os dry-run/execute.

subcommands.name: plan
subcommands.summary: Run a dry-run agent planning task through the scheduler and print memory tracker statistics.

subcommands.name: train
subcommands.summary: Train one known local profile or all known profiles against the durable WDBX store.

subcommands.name: tui
subcommands.summary: Launch the interactive ABI agent REPL. Non-tty input falls back to line mode.

subcommands.name: multi
subcommands.summary: Run Abbey, Aviva, and Abi concurrently via the scheduler.

subcommands.name: spawn
subcommands.summary: Create custom smart-agent workers with optional background scheduler submission.

subcommands.name: browser
subcommands.summary: Plan browser automation locally (dry-run default; external MCP for real navigation).

subcommands.name: os
subcommands.summary: Audit an OS-control command request. execute requires --confirm and the policy allow-list.

commands.name: backends
commands.summary: Show GPU, accelerator, shader, MLIR status, feature flags, and version info
commands.details: Reports truthful linked/native/fallback status for local compute backends, lists all build-time feature flags with their enabled/disabled status, and shows framework version and build info.

commands.name: plugin
commands.details: The list path reads the generated plugin registry; run loads bundled plugins and dispatches by plugin name.

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.summary: Print the generated plugin registry with each installed plugin module.

subcommands.name: run
subcommands.summary: Run a bundled plugin by registry name with optional text input.

commands.name: auth
commands.details: Credential helpers are local; live connectors still require explicit credentials and live transport selection.

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.summary: Show which local connector credentials are configured.

subcommands.name: logout
subcommands.summary: Remove the local ABI credential file when present.

subcommands.name: signin
subcommands.summary: Prompt for a credential and persist it in the local ABI credential file.

commands.name: twilio
commands.summary: Run a local Twilio voice-agent simulation
commands.details: Offline simulation only; live Twilio transport requires explicit connector credentials and live mode elsewhere.

commands.name: tui
commands.details: Launches the interactive diagnostics dashboard when stdin is a terminal; otherwise renders a one-shot dashboard frame. --pane accepts system, plugins, storage/wdbx, scheduler, memory, or 1-5. --plain/--no-color omit ANSI styling for logs. --compact renders only the selected pane. --once forces one-shot output; --interval sets the interactive refresh cadence in milliseconds. --json emits one machine-readable snapshot. --list-panes prints pane names, titles, and hotkeys without launching the dashboard.

args.name: compact
args.help: render only the selected diagnostics pane

args.name: once
args.help: force one-shot output even when stdin is a terminal

args.name: json
args.help: emit one machine-readable JSON dashboard snapshot

args.name: list-panes
args.help: print dashboard pane names, titles, and hotkeys

commands.name: wdbx
commands.summary: Operate WDBX storage, WAL, blocks, stats, and demos
commands.details: Subcommands: db init|verify|compact, block insert|get, query [--limit/--json/--text/--persona], benchmark, simulate (bounded multiway rewriting experiments), cluster status|demo|serve, compute info, secure demo, gpu info, api serve. Query runs hybrid semantic×temporal×causal×persona ranking over a recovered store.

subcommands.name: db
subcommands.summary: Manage segment checkpoints, WAL recovery, and snapshot integrity.

subcommands.name: block
subcommands.summary: Append or inspect SHA-linked conversation blocks in a WDBX checkpoint.

subcommands.name: query
subcommands.summary: Print store stats or run semantic/persona-scoped retrieval over a recovered store.

subcommands.name: benchmark
subcommands.summary: Measure local insert/search timing for the in-process vector store.

subcommands.name: simulate
subcommands.usage: abi wdbx simulate --initial A --rule 'A->AB' --depth 5 [--format json|dot] [--output PATH] [--store PATH]
subcommands.summary: Run a bounded multiway (Wolfram-style) string-rewriting experiment with canonical JSON/DOT export and optional WDBX persistence.

subcommands.name: cluster
subcommands.usage: abi wdbx cluster status | cluster demo [nodes] | cluster serve <port> [node] [host]
subcommands.summary: Run single-node status, in-process consensus demo, or authenticated cluster RPC serving.

subcommands.name: compute
subcommands.summary: Report CPU/GPU/NPU/TPU backend selection and fallback state.

subcommands.name: secure
subcommands.summary: Demonstrate local compression plus reference homomorphic aggregation; not security-audited FHE.

subcommands.name: gpu
subcommands.summary: Report GPU backend capability and native-kernel status.

subcommands.name: api
subcommands.summary: Serve the loopback WDBX REST API; bearer token via ABI_WDBX_REST_TOKEN; TLS via ABI_WDBX_TLS_CERT/KEY (proxy-terminated).

commands.name: scheduler
commands.summary: Report scheduler and memory tracker status
commands.details: Runs a one-shot scheduler status task and reports attached memory tracker counters.

commands.name: nn
commands.summary: Run the miniature character-level demo trainer
commands.details: This is a small local demo trainer, not a production/LLM/distributed trainer.

subcommands.name: train
subcommands.summary: Train the miniature local character model from inline text or a JSONL text field.

subcommands.name: sample
subcommands.summary: Train on <corpus>, then greedily emit k characters from the seed byte.
